name: Tree spirit (Lost City)
overview: It can be ranged or maged safely in a safespot using materials allowed on Entrana. It is not advised to use the bronze axe dropped from the zombies to kill it as the axe is weak and the tree spirit has high defence. It's easy to range the tree spirit, or use magic, with it being weak to fire spells and Crumble Undead. Arrows, unstrung bows, and bow strings are allowed on the island. Simply string the bow when you reach the dungeon. For those who prefer not to use ranged or magic attacks, the ring of recoil is an option. However if you take too long, after about 10 minutes, the spirit will despawn and you will have to refight it. The spirit will respawn after attempting to chop the tree again.
